translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
qasam hai koh-e-toor ki ,
aur uss kitab ki jo aik khulay huye
saheefay mein likhi hoi hai
aur qasam hai bait-e-mamoor ki
aur buland ki hoi chat ki ,
aur bharay huye samandar ki ,
kay tumharay perwerdigar ka azab zaroor waqay honey wala hai ,
koi nahi hai jo ussay rok sakay ,
jiss din aasman thar-thara ker laraz uthay ga ,
aur pahar holnaak tareeqay say chal parren gay ,
tu uss din bari kharabi hogi unn ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain ,
jo beyhooda baaton mein doobay huye khel rahey hain ,
uss din jab unhen dhakkay dey dey ker jahannum ki aag ki taraf dhakela jaye ga ,
. ( kay : )  yeh hai woh aag jiss ko tum jhutlaya kertay thay .
bhala kiya yeh jadoo hai ya tumhen ( abb bhi ) kuch nazar nahi aaraha-?
dakhil hojao iss mein ! phir tum sabar kero , ya naa kero , tumharay liye barabar hai . tumhen unhi kamon ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .
muttaqi log beyshak baaghon aur naimaton mein hon gay ,
unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen jiss tarah nawaza aur unn kay perwerdigar hi ney unhen dozakh kay azab say jiss tarah bachaya , uss ka lutf utha rahey hon gay .
. ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  khoob mazay say khao piyo , unn aemal kay silay mein jo tum kiya kertay thay .
woh aik qetar mein lagi hoi oonchi nishiston per takiya lagaye huye hon gay , aur hum bari bari aankhon wali huroon say unn ka biyah kerden gay .

aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unn ki aulad ney bhi emaan mein unn ki perwi ki hai , to unn ki aulad ko hum unhi kay sath shamil kerden gay , aur unn kay amal mein say kissi cheez ki kami nahi keren gay .   her insan ki jaan apni kamai kay badlay rehan rakhi hoi hai .
aur hum unhen aik kay baad aik phal aur gosht , jo bhi unn ka dil chahye ga , diye chalay jayen gay .
wahan woh aesay jaam sharab per ( dostana ) cheena jhapti ker rahey hon gay jiss mein naa koi beyhoodgi hogi , aur naa koi gunah hoga .
aur unn kay ird-gird woh nojawan phir rahey hon gay jo unhi ( ki khidmat ) kay liye makhsoos hon gay , aesay ( khoobsurat ) jaisay chupa ker rakhay huye moti !
aur woh aik doosray ki taraf mutawajjah ho ker halaat poochen gay ,
kahen gay kay :  hum pehlay jab apney ghar walon ( yani duniya ) mein thay to daray sehmay rehtay thay ,
aakhir Allah ney hum per bara ehsan farmaya , aur hamen jhulsaney wali hawa kay azab say bacha liya .
hum iss say pehlay uss say duayen maanga kertay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay wohi hai jo bara mohsin , boht meharban hai .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay tum apney perwerdigar kay fazal say naa kahin ho , naa majnoon .
bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay :  yeh sahab shaeer hain jinn kay baaray mein hum zamaney ki gardish ka intizar ker rahey hain-?
keh do kay :  kerlo intizar ! mein bhi tumharay sath intizar ker-raha hun .
kiya inn ki aqlen inn ko yehi kuch kernay ko kehti hain , ya woh hain hi sarkash log-?
haan kiya woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  inn sahab ney yeh ( Quran ) khud gharr liya hai ?  nahi ! balkay yeh ( zidd mein ) emaan nahi laarahey .
agar yeh waqaee sachay hain to iss jaisa koi kalam ( gharr ker ) ley ayen .
kiya yeh log baghair kissi kay aap say aap peda hogaye , ya yeh khud ( apney ) khaliq hain-?
ya kiya aasman aur zameen enhon ney peda kiye hain-? nahi ! balkay asal baat yeh hai kay yeh yaqeen nahi rakhtay .
kiya tumharay perwerdigar kay khazaney inn kay paas hain , ya woh darogha banay huye hain-?
ya inn kay pass koi seerhi hai jiss per charh ker yeh ( aalam-e-baala ki baaten ) sunn letay hain . agar aisa hai to inn mein say jo sunta ho , woh koi wazeh saboot to laye .
kiya Allah kay hissay mein to betiyan hain , aur betay tumharay hissay mein aaye hain-?
aur kiya tum inn say koi ujrat maang rahey ho jiss ki wajeh say yeh tawaan kay bojh mein dabay jarahey hain-?
ya inn kay paas ghaib ka ilm hai jissay yeh likh letay hon-?
kiya yeh koi makar kerna chahtay hain-? to dar-haqeeqat jo kafir hain , makar to unhi per parray ga .
kiya Allah kay siwa inn ka koi aur khuda hai-? pak hai Allah uss shirk say jo yeh ker rahey hain !
aur agar yeh aasman ka koi tukrra girtay huye bhi dekh len to yeh kahen gay kay yeh koi gehra badal hai .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum enhen ( inn kay haal per ) chorr do , yahan tak kay yeh apney uss din say jaa milen jiss mein inn kay hosh jatay rahen gay ,
jiss din inn ki makkaari inn kay kuch kaam nahi aaye gi , aur naa enhen koi madad mil sakay gi .
aur iss say pehlay bhi inn zalimon kay liye aik azab hai ,   lekin inn mein say aksar logon  ko pata nahi hai .
aur tum apney perwerdigar kay hukum per jamay raho , kiyonkay tum humari nigahon mein ho ,   aur jab tum uthtay ho , uss waqt apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kiya kero ,
aur kuch raat ko bhi uss ki tasbeeh kero , aur uss waqt bhi jab sitaray doobtay hain .
